concepts.title: Find the Unknowns: Balance Puzzles
concepts.definition: A weighing balance hides numbers: when a pan with unknown weights balances a known total, the unknown is found by removing the known part, the same move equations make with subtraction.
concepts.key_idea: Balance is the picture of equality: whatever one side hides, the other side's surplus reveals.

concepts.title: Equations as Balanced Scales
concepts.definition: An equation like x + 4 = 11 is a balance in symbols: the equals sign promises both sides weigh the same, so whatever is done to one side must be done to the other to keep the balance true.
concepts.key_idea: The equals sign is the balance beam: treat both sides identically and the equation stays honest.

concepts.title: One-Step Equations with Sharing
concepts.definition: When a total is shared equally and only the share is known, the unknown count multiplies: 3 bags hold 12 kg in all, so each bag holds 12 divided by 3, turning sharing stories into division equations.
concepts.key_idea: Sharing splits a total into equal unknowns: divide the known difference or total by the number of shares.

solution_steps.explain: Work out what the equal shares together must add to.

solution_steps.action: divide by the number of shares
solution_steps.explain: Each unknown share is the remaining total divided by the count.

concepts.title: From Stories to Equations
concepts.definition: Word problems become equations by naming the unknown with a letter and translating each phrase: more than becomes addition, together becomes a sum, and left becomes subtraction, ready to be solved.
concepts.key_idea: Translation is the whole trick: read the story once more and each phrase hands over its operation.
